findings.summary: The spec's enumeration deliverable (full-repo PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE occurrence list with per-item disposition, and the parent_handoff_receipt_digest / chain-walker enumeration) is not present as a discrete tree artifact or in the sealed receipt; the substantive answers live in code comments (dd_actors.py:100-115, chain_rules.py module docstring, cost_obs/data_plane.py record_failure_cost). Independent read-only re-enumeration confirms the substantive outcome: no unhandled same-family misclassification site exists, and audit._check_receipt_chain is the only walker needing (and consuming) the retry edge; dd_replay walks sealed per-attempt receipt files and correctly needs no retry edge.

Auxiliary product commit 96e83266 extends tests/test_gate_authority_text.py SCAN_EXCLUDED_DIRS with gitignored tool-cache directories (.venv, .ruff_cache, .pytest_cache). Outside the spec's named deliverables, but necessary for acceptance cmd 2 (make verify) to pass in a worktree carrying those caches; follows the pre-existing exclusion discipline (.git, .dev-dispatch, .dd-evidence, __pycache__); no test deleted or weakened.
